rules.require: roof.west_eave_mm >= 0 [mm] and roof.north_eave_mm >= 0 [mm] and roof.width_mm - roof.west_eave_mm >= floor.width_mm and roof.depth_mm - roof.north_eave_mm >= floor.depth_mm
rules.message: the roof does not cover the floor: the roof's width or depth, less its west or north eave, is smaller than the floor's
rules.note: read from the type fields, the specification, so every placement checks it while no roof can stand on the walls
